title: EPIPE handling removed
detail: The original code handled an EPIPE error by pacifying stdout/stderr and exiting with code 1. The new code only re-raises the exception for non‑EPIPE errors, so a broken pipe will now raise an unhandled OSError instead of silently exiting with 1.

title: Incorrect logical operator in stop()
detail: The condition uses `or` instead of `and`, causing a blank line to be printed even when the console is interactive or a Jupyter notebook, which is not the intended behavior when progress is disabled.
note: Says the blank line is printed when either holds, which the planted `or` does.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted DeferredLock object does not have a 'locked' attribute; the correct method is locked(). This will raise an AttributeError at runtime.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: Acquiring the lock returns a Deferred that must be awaited. Calling it without await blocks the coroutine and can lead to deadlocks or missed lock acquisition.
note: Names the lock acquisition that isn't awaited.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property is documented to return True if ``text/html`` is accepted. The implementation returns True when ``text/html`` is *not* present, which is the opposite of the intended behavior and will cause callers to misinterpret the result.
note: Says accept_html is true when text/html is absent, which the planted `not in` does.
